context:
Goal: build Card in Hand on the Duo with no surprises.
Problem: the iPhone keys span both open pages, so they cover the tab bar under the right page while you type.
Based on: the keyboard measured 951 x 263 pt on the open Duo (measured).
Meanwhile: Duo files your earlier answers. No build lane starts.
holds: Duo's Card in Hand build waits on this.

options.how: The tab bar shows again when the keys close.
options.label: Keep it under the keys
options.lose: You can't switch tabs while typing.

options.how: The tab bar rides just above the keys on the right page.
options.label: Lift it above the keys

ref: Duo build plan; keyboard spans the open screen, 951 x 263 pt (measured 14:03)
title: While you type a card name, the keys cover the tab bar. Keep it or lift it?
why: You rarely switch tabs mid-name, and it's free.
